title: Track A governed authority and durable runtime composition

phases.objective: Compose Context, Capability, Authority, Plan, Approval/Delegation, Track B readiness, Durable, Adapter, Readback, and shared projection-eligibility contracts without minting authority, selecting connections, executing a provider, or creating surface-specific policy engines.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A read-only operation is surface-ready only when every injected stage is explicitly ready and Final Authority is explicitly authoritative and allowed; mutation, shadow authority, context drift, missing dependencies, side-effect evidence, and invalid resource-graph inheritance fail closed.
steps: Resolve authoritative Context Kernel identity and hash
Validate deterministic bounded Resource Graph inheritance, restriction, tenant-isolation, lifecycle, cycle, and depth invariants
Compile capability manifest and verify context-hash binding
Resolve explicit authority preflight, plan, and approval/delegation state
Require explicit authoritative Final Authority and consume Track B readiness evidence
Resolve durable execution, adapter, and readback readiness without dispatching a provider
Project bounded secret-safe readiness evidence for downstream surface projection
assertions: Caller tenant/workspace fields cannot replace the resolved Context Kernel identity downstream
Resource Graph resolution is deterministic under input permutation and cycles cannot duplicate resolved nodes
Active deny restrictions win before inheritance; wildcard denies apply across operations while expired or revoked restrictions do not
Cross-tenant graph contamination, depth overflow, and unapproved inheritance policies fail closed
Shadow or legacy-authoritative evidence cannot satisfy Final Authority
Mutation cutover remains disabled even when approval and authority evidence are supplied
Context hash drift and missing dependencies fail closed
Provider-call, external-write, database-mutation, credential-read, execution, or secret-inclusion evidence blocks readiness
The composition boundary creates no authority, selects no connection, executes no provider, and emits no execution grant

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Dynamic Tabs, Dashboard, and Tool Catalog consume one no-secret projection-eligibility decision; ineligible surfaces reveal no candidate existence, and Tool Catalog action eligibility never becomes execution authorization.
steps: Load one bounded Effective Authority Manifest and registered public surface candidates
Validate manifest expiry and no-secret invariants
Compile Dynamic Tabs and Dashboard visibility from surface projection eligibility
Compile Tool Catalog visibility separately from later action eligibility
Require ready/canary-ready decision plus execution projection/readiness before marking a tool action eligible for later PEP evaluation
Return deterministic public projections with no authority grant, runtime enforcement, provider call, or database mutation
assertions: A surface with projectionEligibility=false returns zero items and does not disclose candidate count or identities
Expired manifests fail closed for all three product surfaces
Shadow-ready manifests may preserve authorized visibility but cannot mark a Tool Catalog action eligible
Tool action eligibility requires execution projection eligibility and execution readiness
action_eligible never implies execution_authorized and no action grant is emitted
Duplicate projection registrations fail closed rather than selecting one candidate
Secret-like fields and URL credentials/query secrets are removed from public metadata
Registration order does not change projection output order
The compiler creates no authority and performs no runtime/provider/database mutation

phases.objective: Bind the composition and projection contracts to repository-canonical live authority and durable readiness implementations after their separate evidence gates are satisfied.
Prove restart, invalidation, authority-revision drift, and unknown-outcome reconciliation through the same composition boundary.
Run read-only composition against an authorized non-production cohort with exact rollback and parity evidence.
Enable a separately authorized production consumer only after live authority, migration/readback, and parity certification.
